title: Open a local Game Menu while the online match keeps running
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement Game Menu as a blocking local glass modal over City Board, with How to Play, Settings and Leave lobby. It is never labeled Pause in multiplayer and explicitly says the live table continues. Opening/closing/nested support views must not stop subscriptions, freeze the authoritative deadline, queue a fake request-advance or leave hidden background CTAs active. Leave requires a deliberate confirmation and delegates authority/session cleanup through the approved lifecycle owner; it does not reset the game for everyone.
acceptance: Game Menu has the approved three routes and clear live-online wording instead of a global pause promise.
Deadline/snapshot updates continue underneath the inert background and are reflected correctly on close.
Nested help/settings and canceled leave restore focus safely without activating background controls.
Confirmed leave emits one allowed callback; no automatic game command, server pause or global state reset occurs.
